name: Danny Chat Widget
author: vidagdhan

sections.description:
Danny Chat Widget adds a stylish and responsive WhatsApp chat icon to your WordPress website. When users click the button, they are redirected to a WhatsApp chat with a predefined message.

Ideal for businesses and support teams who want to quickly connect with visitors on WhatsApp.

Features:

  • Floating WhatsApp button on every page
  • Mobile-friendly design
  • Lightweight and easy to install
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit the phone number and message in the plugin code (or contact us for a pro version with admin panel settings).
sections.faq:
Can I customize the phone number or message?

Yes

Is this plugin free?

Yes
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release with basic WhatsApp chat functionality.
